source_correlation: Eight question roots per subject come from one CBSE SQP family per subject. Questions within a passage/case are additionally clustered. These are not 32 independent examination families.

stimuli.source_question: Q1, printed pages 1-3; source text is 417 words
stimuli.text:
1. Each December, Earth crosses a debris stream associated with asteroid 3200 Phaethon, producing the Geminids. Their activity is high and occurs predictably.
2. The meteors appear to radiate from Gemini, although they can be seen across the sky. This apparent origin, called the radiant, helps identify the shower.
3. The radiant rises higher after midnight, improving the chances of sightings. Telescopes and binoculars are not needed; clouds, atmospheric clarity, moonlight, and light pollution affect visibility.
4. Historical records since the mid-nineteenth century show that Geminid activity has increased steadily. The meteors’ moderate speed is associated with bright, longer-lasting streaks.

stimuli.source_question: Q2, printed pages 3-4; source text is 333 words
stimuli.text:
1. A study tracked changes in everyday payment habits through UPI data for four Octobers.
2. Transaction counts rose from 4.21 billion in October 2021 to 7.30 billion in 2022, 11.40 billion in 2023, and 16.58 billion in 2024.
3. Transaction value also rose: ₹7.71 lakh crore in 2021, ₹12.11 lakh crore in 2022, ₹17.15 lakh crore in 2023, and ₹23.49 lakh crore in 2024.
4. UPI use extended to shops, homes, workplaces, and small roadside vendors, for purchases and services. The paper describes users as more confident in digital payments and notes effects on small businesses and cash use.

items.subject: business_studies
items.question: Who is a consumer under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019?

options.label: A
options.text: It includes any user of such goods or beneficiary of services if such use is made with the disapproval of the buyer.

options.label: B
options.text: It applies to online transactions only which are made through electronic means or by teleshopping or direct selling or multilevel marketing.

options.label: C
options.text: Any person who obtains goods or avails services for resale or commercial purpose.

options.label: D
options.text: A person who buys any goods or avails services for a consideration, which has been paid or promised, or partly paid and partly promised, or under any scheme of deferred payment.

items.subject: business_studies
items.question: Astrio Ltd. is a fast-growing company engaged in manufacturing consumer goods. The management noticed that despite good demand for its products, the company often faced delays in certain activities, while at other times money remained unused for long periods. To address this issue, the finance department decided to prepare a comprehensive plan before undertaking future activities. The company carefully assessed its upcoming business requirements and tried to determine how much money would be needed for different activities and at what stage these requirements would arise. At the same time, the management examined various ways through which funds could be arranged so that financial requirements could be met without disruption. Identify the concept discussed in the above lines.
